requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4770-6967--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Honest Rutstein.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6967--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2105-3499-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3499-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3499-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

803-3899-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-3899-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.

4659-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4659-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-3899-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-3899-4446.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

997-2946-4871-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4871-7316.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

955-1409-3099-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3933-4929-5479-7704.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-7704.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

1395-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2793-3743-5089-6441-7178.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-6441-7178.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5946-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4871-5220-5946-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1308-4682-5140-6753.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-4682-5140-6753.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4682-5140-6753.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

57-2751-4846-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4846-5295.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4067-5042-7064.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4067-5042-7064.description:
Activate Professor Zei's first ability by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards due to Teferi's Ageless Insight.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Professor Zei.
Repeat.

549-850-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
549-850-1978.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat

549-1978-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
549-1978-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat

944-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0} due to Planar Gate, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
944-2034-3693-5224.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to cast Walking Ballista, and then remove counters from it to deal damage.

586-3375-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1913-2073-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
1913-2073-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Repeat.

360-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

549-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
549-2743-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2730-2921-4871-5006.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2730-2921-4871-5006.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

2060-2313-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Conclave Mentor.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

938-4050-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard by paying {U}.
Repeat.

1303-2974-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Repository Skaab.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Repository Skaab, adding {B}.
When Repository Skaab dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its exploit ability and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of it.
When the Repository Skaab token enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger from step 4, sacrificing the Repository Skaab token.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Feign Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

880-2653-3678.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

369-2034-2386-2579.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2034-2386-2579.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding {C}{C}.
When Iridescent Drake dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Iridescent Drake on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Iridescent Drake from your library onto the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

1308-4050-4533-4807.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
1308-4050-4533-4807.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House

1432-4284-4600.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
1432-4284-4600.description:
Activate Clone's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature you control.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Clone and another legendary creature you control.
Repeat.

254-301-1099.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
254-301-1099.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}, causing all creatures that enter the battlefield under your control this turn to get an additional +1/+1 counter put on it.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
Putrid Goblin's persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering First Day of Class, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability from step 2, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1015-1744-2773-3023.notablePrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
1015-1744-2773-3023.description:
Cast Skithiryx by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Skithiryx enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, giving an opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Skithiryx.
Put all five Skithiryx tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Warstorm Surge triggers for each Skithiryx token.
Resolve the first Skithiryx trigger, giving an opponent seven poison counters.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.

538-2034-5003-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding {C}{C}.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damages to each opponent.
Repeat.

65-717-881-2628-5181.description:
Cycle Scattered Groves for {0} due to Fluctuator.
Escape Protocol and Bone Miser trigger.
Stack the triggers such that Bone Miser's ability resolves first, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability using {1} to pay for it to blink Golgari Findbroker.
When Golgari Findbroker ETBs, return Scattered Groves to your hand.
Resolve the cycling trigger and draw a card.
